chunks: And Ali ibn Ahmad informed us, saying: Ubaydullah ibn Musa narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn narrated to us, from Safwan ibn Yahya, who said: Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) said:
By Allah, that which you look forward to will not come to pass until you are tested and distinguished, and until none of you remains except the rarest of the rare.

key_terms.أَعْيُنَكُمْ: Your eyes (metaphor for looking forward to or desiring)
key_terms.أَنْدَرُ: The rarest, most exceptional, or finest
key_terms.تُمَيَّزُوا: You are distinguished or separated (from the weak)
key_terms.تُمْحَصُوا: You are tested, sifted, or purified

ai.seo_question: What conditions must be met before the reappearance of the Mahdi according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) elucidates the doctrine of *al-Tamhish* (purification through testing), asserting that the Mahdi's reappearance is contingent upon a rigorous筛选 process that eliminates the weak and hypocritical from the Shia community. This hadith, central to al-Nu'mani's discussion on sectarian fragmentation during the Minor and Major Ghaiba, underscores that the 'Ander' (the elite) are those who remain steadfast amidst the trials of the Disappearance, ensuring the preservation of authentic belief.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (15) Ali bin Ahmad narrated from Obaydillah bin Musa from Muhammad bin al-Husayn from Safwan bin Yahya that Abul Hasan ar-Redha (as) had said:
“By Allah, That, which you look forward to, will not be until you are tested and clarified and until none of you remains save the least and the least.”
